jobs.title: Social Media & Campaign Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Cell Labs Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Content-Produktion: Du produzierst Shorts, Reels und Posts für LinkedIn, Instagram und YouTube, vor und hinter der Kamera. Vom ersten Konzept über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Schnitt. Social-Media-Redaktion: Du verantwortest unseren Redaktionsplan und entscheidest, welches Thema auf welchem Kanal läuft. Du machst aus einem Engineering-Fortschritt einen LinkedIn-Post, aus einem Testlauf ein Video und aus einem Meilenstein einen Moment, über den geredet wird. Community Management: Du sichtest Kommentare und Nachrichten, antwortest im Tagesgeschäft und erkennst, wann ein Thema an das Team oder die Gründer:innen geflaggt werden muss. Kampagnen & Launch: Du setzt Kampagnen operativ um, insbesondere die Kommunikation rund um unseren Produktlaunch: von Teasern über Content vor Ort bis zum Recap. Mit Creator:innen und Partnern arbeitest du dabei eng zusammen. Founder-Content: Du recherchierst Themen und schreibst Entwürfe für LinkedIn-Beiträge, die unsere Gründer:innen aus ihrer eigenen Perspektive veröffentlichen. Du entwickelst eigene Formate aus unserem Material: Unser Videograf kümmert sich um Dokumentation und aufwendige Produktionen. Du machst daraus eigene Formate, schneidest Snippets und organisierst kleinere Drehs selbst. Reporting: Du misst Reichweite, Engagement und Profilbesuche, wertest aus, was fun

Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah. You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs. Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods. Above all, we are looking for people who will  make HelloFresh   better.  We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. What you’ll do Process and Equipment Design: You will actively design, evaluate, and refine DC layouts, operational workflows, and physical equipment setups for our next-generation production models. Project Deployment & Rollout: Working cross-functionally, you will be the driving force for the end-to-end implementation and deployment of production technologies. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. You will train and deploy modern neural robotic policies for real customer tasks. This is an early-career role for someone whose strongest experience may come from a university laboratory, thesis, internship, or recent research position. We care about the depth of your work and your ability to learn quickly, not the number of years on your CV. Run experiments in simulation and transfer successful policies onto real robots. Collect demonstrations and deployment data, diagnose failure modes, and improve policies iteratively. Evaluate models for robustness, generalisation, latency, and real-world task success. Work alongside deployment engineers at customer sites to adapt policies to new environments and workflows. jobs.title: Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command. Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened. What is your Day to Day Mission: Provision Software and Firmware Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed. Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration. Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures. Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet). jobs.description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Deine Mission bei uns Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei un

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist | DE
jobs.description: Who we are At supermodular.ai, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution. Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization. That’s why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled. Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you’ll feel at home at supermodular.ai. Your role supermodular.ai operates through three core roles: AI Strategy, Deployment Strategy and Forward Deployed Engineering. As a Deployment Strategist, you are responsible for translating AI strategy into a live enterprise engagement. You own delivery inside the account, including stakeholder management, prioritization, execution and the initiatives we commit to next. You work directly with enterprise leaders, engineers and operators to understand how their systems and workflows function today, identify where AI can create meaningful operational impact and shape initiatives that can realistically be deployed inside the organization

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role The parts you cut go into aircraft, defence systems, energy infrastructure and robots. This is a hands-on machining role at our Southwark factory in London, where you own your work from set-up to finished part rather than handing it down a line. The factory is growing quickly, so you will help improve how it runs rather than wait for someone else to. We run early and late shifts, and the package includes equity. Set up, prove out and run jobs on 3-axis and 5-axis machines to aerospace and defence standards. Edit and optimise programmes at the machine, and work with our CAM programmers on toolpaths. Choose fixturing, tooling and cutting parameters for aluminium, steels, titanium and nickel alloys. Hold tight tolerances and check your own work before it goes to inspection. Own cycle time and machine utilisation on your shift. What you bring Production experience setting and running high-end CNC machines such as Hermle, DMG Mori or Mazak. A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm or tighter. A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling and workholding, and confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T. Comfort working shifts in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. Useful, not essential: CAM programming (hyperMILL, Fusion, Mastercam or similar), 5-axis simultaneous machining, probing or pallet systems, aerospace or defence work, or AS9100 familiarity. Jiga fixes this by connecting engineers directly with vetted manufacturers (CNC, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing). jobs.description: Uniti AI | New York City or London (Hybrid) Uniti AI is a New York City-based Series A startup building advanced AI sales and support agents for the real estate industry. As a Staff/Principal Product Engineer, you will own problems end to end: talking to customers, digging into the data, deciding what's worth building, and then building it yourself. This is not a product management role, and it is not a frontend role. You will spend your time in discovery and in the codebase, shipping proofs of concept and MVPs that prove out whether an idea deserves to become part of the core product. Our core product is our agents, our harness, and the agentic workflows that run on them, so this is deep systems and AI work. This role reports to the Head of Product and sits alongside our platform engineering team. If you would rather own the long-term architecture and scaling of the core platform than chase new product bets, look at our Staff/Principal Software Engineer opening instead. Responsibilities Own the full arc of a product bet: research and discovery, customer and data analysis, scoping, then building the proof of concept or MVP yourself. Work directly with customers and the go-to-market team to understand where our agents fall short and what would move the needle. Design and build agentic workflows, agent harness improvements, tool integrations, and the backend systems behind them. Make the call on what to build, what to cut, and what to kill, backed by evidence rather than opinion. Hand off proven prototypes to the platform engineering team, or productionize them yourself when that's the faster path. Set the bar for how we evaluate agent quality: evals, instrumentation, and the metrics that tell us whether something actually works. Collaborate directly with the Head of Product and the founders on product direction and technical strategy. Debug and solve problems across the stack, no "not my job" mentality. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years building and shipping production

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 10x YoY . The role You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it) Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel What we’re looking for We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation. jobs.description: L’ Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe “Personnes morales” du domaine Annuaires, au sein de la Direction des Opérations (DOPS) , chargée de la refonte du répertoire FINESS . La nouvelle version du référentiel est en service depuis juillet 2026 et les travaux de mise en qualité des données se poursuivent, notamment sur les données SIRENE et sur les informations relatives aux structures sanitaires et médico-sociales. Référentiel national essentiel à l’identification des établissements, FINESS contribue au pilotage de l’offre de soins, au financement et au contrôle des structures, à l’orientation des usagers et à l’interopérabilité des systèmes d’information en santé. Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe produit pluridisciplinaire organisée en méthode Scrum. 🎯 Missions principales Analyse et fiabilisation des données Analyser la qualité des données SIRENE présentes dans le référentiel FINESS et reprendre les travaux de la précédente campagne. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder. Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois. En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance. VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle : 1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal) Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€). Vente consultative : vous engagez un dialogue direct et qualitatif avec des investisseurs exigeants (dirigeants, cadres supérieurs, entrepreneurs) pour qualifier leur potentiel, lever leurs freins et conclure les souscriptions. Animation et réinvestissement : vous réactivez notre communauté d'investisseurs autour des lancements

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook. You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité. Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone. Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites. It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism. What will you work on? At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together. Our current data platform includes: Ingestion: Stitch Data warehouse: BigQuery Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference. This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations. jobs.description: Als HR Adviseur binnen Matrix Fitness ben je een echte HR generalist en houd jij je bezig met het algehele personeelsbeleid en de salarisadministratie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor jouw afdelingen waarvoor je het volledige HR beleid operationeel handen en voeten geeft. Is dit jouw volgende uitdaging? Jouw sportieve uitdaging: Het betreft een generalistische adviseursrol waarbij je jouw afdelingen faciliteert in de volledige HR dienstverlening. Van het werven van nieuwe collega’s tot het faciliteren van een goede offboarding, alle facetten komen in deze rol voorbij. Zo ben je ook verantwoordelijk voor het stroomlijnen en bijhouden van onze HR-administratie met behulp van ons personeelssysteem (AFAS) en beheer je het volledige scala aan operationele HR-taken voor het personeel. Hierbij kun je denken aan het monitoren en uitvoeren van het administratieve in- en uitdienst proces, verzuimbegeleiding van begin tot eind binnen de afdeling, het beantwoorden van HR gerelateerde vraagstukken vanuit jouw afdelingen en jouw manager en het proactief adviseren van leidinggevenden. Naast de verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw eigen afdelingen en de salarisadministratie, draag je ook de verantwoordelijkheid voor het thema ‘Vitaliteit', waarbij je een vitaliteitsdraaiboek uitvoert, bijhoudt en iedere twee jaar vernieuwd. Kortom, een veelzijdige functie waarin je de ruimte hebt om een significante impact te maken op belangrijke HR-onderwerpen binnen onze organisatie. jobs.description: Über die Position: Was steckt in der Box Als Senior Production Planner (all genders) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Produktionskapazitäten und Personalressourcen optimal auf den geplanten Produktionsbedarf abgestimmt sind. Personalplanung: Du leitest den Personalbedarf aus Produktionsvolumen, Schichtmodellen und Produktivitätskennzahlen ab und stimmst ihn mit den verfügbaren Ressourcen ab. At Fin, we don’t just sell products; we empower businesses to reimagine their customer support strategies. jobs.description: Venture Development Manager – Heat Pump Sales (m/w/d) Build a sales channel. Scale a business. Make an impact. Unser Ziel ist es, die Energiewende in jeden Haushalt zu bringen. Bei Enpal machen wir das möglich – mit einer integrierten Energielösung aus Solaranlagen, Batteriespeichern, Wallboxen und Wärmepumpen. Als Deutschlands erstes grünes Unicorn gestalten wir einen der dynamischsten Märkte Europas und bauen unser Geschäft kontinuierlich weiter aus. Deine Mission Wie baut man aus einem erfolgreichen Vertriebskanal ein skalierbares Geschäftsmodell? Als Venture Development Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für einen unserer zentralen externen Vertriebspartner im Wärmepumpengeschäft. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für die Sales Agency und verantwortest gemeinsam mit ihr die Performance und Weiterentwicklung eines Netzwerks von rund 50 selbstständigen Vertriebsmitarbeitern. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Business Development, Sales und Operations: Du identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale, entwickelst konkrete Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Vertriebsergebnisse und setzt diese eigenständig um. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team zusammen, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und hast die Möglichkeit, einen wichtigen Vertriebskanal von Enpal aktiv mitzugestalten. Es geht nicht darum, bestehende Prozesse nur zu verwalten – sondern darum, ein funktionierendes System auf das nächste Level zu bringen. Deine Verantwortung Own the Sales Partnership: Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für eine unserer wichtigsten externen Vertriebsagenturen und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit sowie das Netzwerk von rund 50 selbstständigen Sales Representatives kontinuierlich weiter. Drive Sales Performance: Du analysierst Vertriebszahlen, Conversion Rates und weitere KPIs, identifizierst Performance-Hebel und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung der Ergebnisse ab. Build & Scale: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Agentur Strategien, um das Vertriebsnetzwerk

At rebuy, data science isn’t a side project. The models your team builds ship to production and directly shape what we buy, what we sell and at what price. We care about outcomes, not just predictions, and we’re looking for someone who connects commercial priorities with technical execution. You are a player-coach: you lead from inside the work. Sometimes that means unblocking your team, aligning requirements with Commercial or translating business strategy into clear technical deliverables. Sometimes it means reviewing an architecture, pairing on a tricky modeling problem or shipping code yourself. You set the priorities and the pace, make sure the team’s work reaches production, and keep the quality bar high across our models and pipelines. Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste. Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet. Key Responsibilities: Lead and grow your team: Manage, mentor and coach a focused team of Senior Data Scientists through regular 1:1s, clear performance expectations and support for their career growth. Build a culture where impact counts more than model accuracy alone Own the roadmap: Work with Commercial and Data leadership to turn commercial goals into an actionable data science roadmap. Own prioritization, capacity planning

Technisches Know-how, hohe Qualitätsansprüche und eine enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Fachbereichen bilden die Grundlage für den Erfolg des Unternehmens. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity. We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice. Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves. The Opportunity Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously. Dann passt diese Stelle zu dir. Wir sind die Von Strünck Recruiting & Consulting GmbH aus Düsseldorf. Wir helfen mittelständischen Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland, vom Handwerksbetrieb bis zum Ingenieurbüro, über Social Media die richtigen Mitarbeiter zu finden. Als Telefonist in unserem Recruiting-Team bist du die erste Stimme, die unsere Bewerber hören. jobs.description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. The mission Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand. Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets. You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet. Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet. jobs.description: We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You'll join the Security team under the CSO. You will lead Ledger's security risk governance and assurance, emphasise our answers to institutional customers' security requirements, and the evidence that our controls work. What you’ll be doing: Be the customer-facing voice of Ledger's risk and assurance position: due diligence, audits, contract security reviews and calls with customer security and risk teams. Run enterprise security risk governance, the quality of the risk register and the records of risk acceptance. Manage the ISO 27001 programme and prepare SOC 2 readiness.
